## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap must be fixed before merge because the helper exceeds the project’s five-attempt limit.

## Changes
Adds `fetch_with_retry` with retry validation, delays, and tests for recovery, exhaustion, and bounds. The pinned diff also raises the documented cap to ten and adds a text fixture.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt retry cap — When an upstream remains unavailable, the default call makes ten attempts, violating AGENTS.md:5: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” Validation also permits explicit counts from six through ten. — During an upstream outage, callers generate excess requests and wait through additional timeouts beyond the mandated retry budget.
